name: SquircleKeycaps
description: An invented runbook automation product where every control on the page is a generated keycap
intent: One primitive generated in JavaScript, and it is every control on the page. A superellipse walked in code rather than a border-radius, extruded into a key that travels when pressed, with the widths measured off a canvas instead of guessed.
